result.title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
result.summary: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TrainExplorer 多智能体框架，通过基于文献的策略规划与规划—执行解耦，自主探索 LLM 后训练方案，并在 PostTrainBench 上以加权总分 39.02 超过若干强基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单组件干预＋归因」的解耦执行思路，可能可供核查用于 LVR 训练监督中的贡献分配与干扰因素隔离；但研究对象是纯文本后训练策略搜索，与视觉推理状态生成无直接关联，线索需较多核查。
